methodology.fold: reference @flop-labs/tclk applyFrame over board export + each derived deal room export, each frame replayed at its own timestamp; frames whose inner from != transport signer are discarded
methodology.claimed: reveal accepted by the state machine (secret opens the statement, before refundAfter)
methodology.stranded_accept: fold-valid accept whose offer expired with no lock from the payer
methodology.malformed: tclk1-prefixed line the fail-closed decoder rejects (unknown key, bad shape) or a from/signer mismatch
methodology.score: deals_claimed × (1 + 0.25 × min(counterparties, 8)) − 0.5 × refunded − 0.25 × malformed; counterparties = distinct keys a deal reached lock with
methodology.caveats: read-side; PAPER rail holds nothing, so this is choreography reputation not money; deal rooms beyond the read budget are skipped, newest first
